15d.name: Commenting on posts
15d.status: Full execution window within the 15-day plan; requires Custom input detection gate to be resolved by day 1.

steps.text: Implement and verify 'Custom input detection' capability (gate) as part of 'Package top-3 workflows' or standalone sprint, ensuring seat frees + work time allocation.
Scaffold commenting workflow: define target platforms, tone guidelines, and input parsing logic using the newly enabled custom input detection.
First run: Execute automated comments on low-risk posts to validate pipeline stability and latency.
Verify engagement metrics and finalize workflow for steady-state operation; outcome completes within window.

15d.name: Generate daily social media posts
15d.status: Full execution window within the 15-day plan; requires Custom input detection gate to be resolved by day 1.

steps.text: Finalize 'Custom input detection' (gate) integration with content generation pipeline, leveraging 'Milestone Auto-Draft Trigger' infrastructure if applicable.
Scaffold daily post generator: connect custom inputs to LLM prompt templates and scheduling queue.
First run: Generate and publish first batch of daily posts; monitor for formatting errors or API failures.
Verify content quality and scheduling accuracy; outcome completes within window.

15d.name: Making phone calls
15d.status: Full execution window within the 15-day plan; Mic access gate is already reached, so no blocking dependencies.

steps.text: Scaffold call automation: configure telephony API connections and voice synthesis parameters using existing Mic access capability.
First run: Execute test calls to verify audio quality, latency, and connection stability.
Stabilize workflow: integrate call logging with 'Daily $ ledger' and handle edge cases (no-answer, busy signals).
Verify end-to-end reliability; outcome completes within window.

15d.name: Writing valid tenders
15d.status: Execution starts day 4 and continues past day 15; requires Camera access gate to be resolved by day 1.

steps.text: Implement 'Camera access' capability (gate) to enable document scanning/OCR for tender inputs, aligned with 'seat frees + work time'.
Scaffold tender generation pipeline: define template structures and integrate camera-based input parsing.
First run: Generate draft tenders for available opportunities; validate compliance with specific tender requirements.
Stabilize and refine: iterate on feedback from generated tenders, improve accuracy of extracted data, and automate submission checks.
Continues to day 14 of the 30-day plan: Finalize remaining tender drafts and prepare for post-day-15 review cycles.

15d.name: Making money (revenue channels live)
15d.status: Full execution window within the 15-day plan; requires Custom input detection and Camera access gates to be resolved by day 1.

steps.text: Resolve both 'Custom input detection' and 'Camera access' gates (as per previous entries) to unblock revenue channel setup.
Scaffold revenue channels: configure payment gateways, link service offerings (from tenders/social posts), and set up tracking in 'Daily $ ledger'.
First run: Activate first revenue channel (e.g., freelance tender submission or social media lead generation) and process initial transactions.
Stabilize operations: monitor transaction success rates, optimize conversion funnels, and ensure ledger accuracy.
Verify revenue flow consistency; outcome completes within window, setting up for 'Positive money income' later in the 30-day plan.

15d.name: Predicting markets
15d.status: Execution starts day 5 and continues past day 15; no specific gates listed, but relies on researcher lane capabilities.

steps.text: Scaffold prediction models: define data sources, feature engineering pipelines, and baseline algorithms using 'Repetitive-task inventory' insights.
First run: Execute initial market predictions on historical data; validate accuracy against known outcomes.
Stabilize and refine: tune model parameters, integrate real-time data feeds, and establish confidence scoring mechanisms.
Continues to day 20 of the 30-day plan: Prepare for live prediction deployment and ongoing monitoring cycles.

15d.name: Positive money income (net > 0) - prep
15d.status: Outcome starts day 19, so this entry covers prerequisite gate work and setup that must finish by day 15 to ensure the 30-day plan holds.

steps.text: Ensure 'Making money (revenue channels live)' prerequisites (Custom input detection, Camera access) are fully resolved and stable.
Execute 'Making money (revenue channels live)' to establish active revenue streams; this is the direct gate for positive income.
Verify that revenue channels are generating consistent gross income and that cost tracking in 'Daily $ ledger' is accurate, preparing for net-positive calculation starting day 19.
